name: Verify assistant offers ticket creation when knowledge is insufficient
objective: Validate that when no relevant knowledge article exists, the assistant informs the user and offers to create a ticket.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. The issue described does not match any knowledge articles.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Describe an issue that has no matching knowledge article
steps.testData: "My custom application XYZ-Widget is showing error code QR-9999"
steps.expectedResult: Message is submitted to the assistant

steps.description: Verify the assistant indicates no relevant knowledge is available
steps.expectedResult: The assistant communicates that it could not find a matching knowledge article

steps.description: Verify the assistant offers to create a ticket
steps.expectedResult: The assistant offers to create a ticket for further assistance
